name: Palo Alto
description: Security rules of a PAN-OS firewall or Panorama, turned into flows
author: Solid Geeks

file.label: Import a configuration file
file.help: On the firewall: Device › Setup › Operations › Export named configuration snapshot (running-config.xml). On Panorama: Panorama › Setup › Operations, same export; then give the device group below. Allow rules become flows: address objects are matched to the assets of the IS by IP, public addresses and FQDNs to Internet services.

fields.label: Firewall or Panorama URL (XML API)
fields.help: Leave empty to only import configuration files.

fields.label: API key (read-only admin role)
fields.help: Or give a user name and password below: the key is then generated at each run.

fields.label: Firewall asset the flows cross
fields.help: Usually the firewall itself; suggested from the IS.

fields.label: Only this vsys or device group
fields.placeholder: vsys1, or the Panorama device group (empty = all)

fields.label: Largest address range expanded into its assets
fields.help: A range holding more assets than this is reported instead of drawn.

fields.label: Remove flows imported earlier whose rule is gone
